sar.narrative: On or about 2016-11-01 17:44:24, financial institution detection systems identified suspicious activity associated with account holder C10320 on card C10320-K1. Transaction 3419313 in the amount of $2941.53 was executed via the in_person channel (W). The transaction exhibited significant anomalies including 2941.5x deviation from historical median spending . Contact was initiated with the cardholder, who confirmed that the transaction was unauthorized and executed without their consent. The identified activity represents confirmed out of region use with total unauthorized exposure of $2941.53. In accordance with federal Bank Secrecy Act and Suspicious Activity Reporting guidelines, the compromised card has been placed under permanent block and scheduled for reissue, and all connected network entities are subject to ongoing monitoring.
